doc: The battle choreography's sound layers (M3-AUD-13; game/audio/choreo_audio.gd, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md 'Choreography layers'). Listen-only: hooks name the battle-presentation track's classes and signals by NAME, so this loads without them. BattleVfx already plays the element hit on BattleChoreo's contact (battle_sfx.json), so nothing here doubles it: the strike's whoosh lands its crest on the contact, the weapon's accent is a softer layer on it, and footfalls, the KO collapse, the Swell accents, the toll wave, the flood and the Vowbound's motion fill what has no particle. Every sound value is an sfx row (sfx_choreo.json). hooks: [{class, signals {role: signal}}]; roles beat (kind, actor_id) and contact (result). styles: per BattleChoreo style id (choreo.json styles): approach / return (a footfall row) with approach_steps / return_steps spread over the beat; strike (a whoosh row) and strike_by_weapon {weapon: row, '' for none}; contact (a row, '@weapon' for the actor's weapon accent, '' for none) and contact_by_weapon; needs_hit (default true for '@weapon'): only when a blow landed for damage. skills: a skill id's contact row first ('' silences it). peaks: each whoosh row's seconds to its crest (assets_src/sfx/choreo_sfx.py PEAKS). weapons: a fighter's base id -> its weapon kind (equipment.json gear_types; Kerrid's anchor-cleaver; the creatures), weapon_default for the rest; accents: weapon kind -> its contact row. no_steps: base ids that never walk (fliers, the bell). ko: a felled fighter's collapse (not a Vowbound's: vowbound.fall). enter / step_off: a fighter walking onto or off its mark (BattleChoreo.entering / leaving). vowbound: call (the caller's call, on BattleVowbound.called), rise / rise_long (the entry; rise_long when it lasts long_sec or more), sink (dismissal), fall. flood: sfx, each active member's brace on the engine's phase_changed to the boss's flood phase, once the action playing is done, stagger_sec apart; phase and stagger_sec are read from choreo.json bosses.<boss>.flood (BattleChoreo.data), so the brace's sound and motion share one number (phase / stagger_sec here only as a fallback). reduced_skip: what reduced audio drops (contact accents, steps).
